backend/main.mo: Motoko canister with access‑controlled user profiles and CRUD-like food entry logging per caller principal.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature IDs, descriptions, related files, components, tests, and confidence for implemented frontend features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries for many frontend files describing their purpose and functionality.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining design tokens and light/dark theme variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes and an authentication gate that enforces login and profile setup.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Internet Identity login/logout button that handles auth flow and clears React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Dialog prompting first‑time users to enter a display name and save their profile.
frontend/src/components/camera/CapturedP: Displays a captured photo with retake and continue actions before moving to estimation.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatTranscr: Renders a scrollable chat transcript with message bubbles, timestamps, and optional citation badges, auto-scrolling on new messages.
frontend/src/components/chat/SuggestedPr: Displays a list of suggested questions as buttons that trigger a callback when selected.
frontend/src/components/entries/DateRang: Shows a date range with previous/next controls and formats day numbers into readable dates.
frontend/src/components/entries/EmptyEnt: Provides a visual empty state encouraging users to add or scan food entries.
frontend/src/components/entries/EntryDet: Displays a dialog with detailed nutritional information for a food entry, adjusted by portion size and confidence level.
frontend/src/components/entries/Estimati: Allows users to review and edit nutrition estimates from a captured photo before submitting a new food entry.
frontend/src/components/entries/PortionC: Provides sliders for adjusting portion size and confidence level with optional guidance text.
frontend/src/components/entries/TodayEnt: Lists today's food entries with adjusted calories and confidence badges, opening a detail dialog on selection.
frontend/src/components/graphs/CaloriesO: Generates a line chart of daily calorie totals over a selected range and supports selecting days from the chart.
frontend/src/components/graphs/MacroDist: Creates a pie chart showing total protein, carbs, and fat distribution across entries.
frontend/src/components/graphs/Nutrition: Calculates a nutrition balance score from macro percentages and confidence levels, then displays the grade, score, and explanatory details. Uses React hooks and a progress bar UI component.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Renders the top navigation bar with links, branding, user profile display, and login button. Integrates router navigation and responsive design.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Provides the main page layout with theme provider, header, footer, and toaster notifications. Wraps child content in a centered container.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when the actor changes. Returns the actor instance and loading state.
Fetches suggested questions from the backend and provides a helper to find matching answers or fallbacks. Depends on the actor for data retrieval.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Queries and mutates the caller's user profile through the backend actor, with automatic cache invalidation. Exposes loading and fetched state helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useFoodEntries.ts: Retrieves food entries for a date range and provides a mutation to add new entries. Invalidates cached food entry queries on updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Handles Internet Identity authentication, storing identity state, login flow, logout, and context access. Wraps the app to provide identity persistence and status.
frontend/src/hooks/usePortionAdjusterGui: Fetches portion adjustment guidance text from the backend actor. Enabled only when the actor is available.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and custom CSS variables for light and dark themes with a health‑focused color palette. Applies global background, text, and border styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root component. Imports global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AddEntryPage.tsx: Form page for manually adding a food entry with macros, micronutrients, portion, and confidence before submitting via a mutation.
frontend/src/pages/CameraCapturePage.tsx: Camera-based food scanning page that captures photos, previews them, and transitions to nutrition estimation.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Main dashboard showing today’s totals, charts, and lists of entries with date-range selection.
frontend/src/pages/HelperChatPage.tsx: Chat interface using a local knowledge base to answer nutrition questions with prompts and message history.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login screen using Internet Identity to authenticate users before accessing the app.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, persisting, and clearing URL parameters and session values.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS config extending typography, container queries, animations, colors, fonts, and layout settings with several plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing a diet-tracking app’s goals, architecture notes, required images, and a list of existing feature definitions.
